en.general: Digital technologies and AI systems are now part of the cultural environment in which human cognition, learning, and social organization develop. Understanding this coevolution is increasingly essential for human self-understanding.

extensions.oe:fullStatement: CROSS-CUTTING THEME 6 -- Machine-Culture Coevolution: Digital technologies, algorithmic systems, and artificial intelligence are now deeply embedded in the cultural environments in which human cognition, learning, social organization, and knowledge production develop.
extensions.oe:sensitiveTopicNote: Some students may have significant anxiety about AI and automation. Frame engagement with these topics as developing understanding and agency, not amplifying fear. Be aware of significant digital equity differences.

oe:strandActivation.activationNote: Primary strand -- machine-culture coevolution as an extension of cultural evolution theory; computational models of cultural transmission; social media as a new medium for conformity bias and prestige bias
Primary strand -- how digital environments shape cognitive development; social media and learning biases; AI systems and theory of mind; human-AI social cognition
